_comment: Copy to calendars.json (gitignored). Keys are user_ids from the users table -- see jarvis_memory/seed.py USERS. A key that is not in that table is skipped with a warning, so add the person first: python3 tools/add_user.py <id> "Имя".
_comment_daniel: iCloud needs an app-specific password from appleid.apple.com (the account password will not work with two-factor on). Put it in .env as DANIEL_ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD -- never inline here. `calendars` restricts sync to those display names; drop it to take every calendar on the account, holidays and shared ones included.
_comment_google: For Google, use the calendar's 'secret address in iCal format' (Settings -> the calendar -> Integrate calendar). It is a plain HTTPS GET with no OAuth, which is why ICS is the route for Google rather than CalDAV. The URL is a credential: it grants read access to the whole calendar.
